title: Med Bed Sensory Tank
summary: A flotation pod combining violet photobiomodulation, 432 Hz resonance, and biofeedback — built as a healing chamber and portal into Astral.
description:
Concept recovered and refined from earlier Blessed Raven notes.

A sensory-deprivation tank (≈2.5 × 1.5 × 1.2 m) filled with warm Epsom brine, paired with pulsed violet light (400–450 nm, dream-derived 4.356 Hz cue), binaural sound, and HRV/EEG biofeedback. The intent: cellular repair via photobiomodulation, deep theta states, and a clean handoff into the Astral BCI experience.

Still early — dimensions and frequencies are design targets, not validated lab results. Needs safer engineering review, medical disclaimers, and a bench-scale light/sound prototype before any full pod.

title: Astral — The Game
summary: A VR journey through seven astral levels, steered by brainwaves and heart signals via the Silver Cord / Sutratma BCI.
description:
Concept recovered and refined from earlier Blessed Raven notes.

Players explore seven layers of an astral plane in VR, with avatar control mapped from EEG and heart magnetic resonance rather than controllers. Designed to pair with the Med Bed: sensory quiet outside, vivid navigation inside. Difficulty and pacing adapt to HRV and brainwave state.

Rough vision — strong fantasy systems design, thin on shipping software. Next refine: one playable level, a simple OpenBCI (or mock) input path, and a mood/art bible in the black-and-white concept-art lane.

title: Torus Energy System
summary: A hole-less superconducting torus aimed at continuous, self-organizing energy flow — a hardware sketch of the yellow-light torus cosmology.
description:
Concept recovered and refined from earlier Blessed Raven notes.

Prototype sketch: ~1 m superconducting (e.g. YBCO) hole-less torus in vacuum at cryogenic temps, helical coils shaping a Seed-of-Life / quatrefoil magnetic well, LC resonance near 10 MHz, yellow (570–590 nm) photonic cueing, sensor + microcontroller feedback, inductive extraction (target ~1 kW class, scalable in theory).

Very rough and physically ambitious — cryogenics, superconductors, and “unlimited free energy” claims need hard skepticism and incremental experiments. Treat as a research direction: model the field geometry first; do not market as working power tech yet.

title: Torus Pyramid Nexus
summary: A Giza-inspired pyramid above the Clutha / Mata-Au as a magnetic and cultural nexus — site, shrine, and torus-energy test bed.
description:
Concept recovered and refined from earlier Blessed Raven notes.

Architectural / spiritual idea: a pyramid structure in New Zealand’s Clutha / Mata-Au landscape, framed as a meeting point of Egyptian, Greek, and Druid mystery schools, with smaller home pyramid replicas for meditation and alignment work tied to Med Bed / Astral sessions.

Needs refining into two tracks: (1) poetic site vision and cultural respect for Kāi Tahu context, (2) any actual magnetic or acoustic experiments that can be tested at tabletop scale without claiming sacred engineering miracles.

title: Yellow Light Torus Theory
summary: A hole-less yellow-electromagnetic-light torus as a unifying picture of consciousness, cosmology, and energy.
description:
Concept recovered and refined from earlier Blessed Raven notes (Theory of Everything page).

Core claim: the universe as a continuous, hole-less torus of yellow electromagnetic light identified with consciousness — clockwise rotation, biophoton brain coupling, resonance and oscillation as co-creation mechanics, collective emotion shaping shared reality. Practical hook: the Torus Energy System as an applied echo of the same geometry.

Philosophical / speculative framework more than empirical physics. Next refine: a short whitepaper separating metaphor, testable claims, and engineering implications — so industry and education partners know which layer they’re talking to.

title: DNA Light & Resonance Repair
summary: Research thread on photobiomodulation and resonance for DNA repair — sister concept to the Med Bed.
description:
Concept recovered and refined from the Immortality page.

Explores light- and resonance-based approaches to cellular repair and longevity, including the idea of preserving genetic legacy for a future where repair tech matures. Closely coupled to Med Bed light protocols.

Very early and ethically sensitive. Refinement path: literature map of real photobiomodulation evidence, clear non-medical framing, and lab partners — not consumer immortality claims.
